Suppose you have been provided with 200 semi-spherical shaped dye molecules which 15   
are two times wider than their widths and having a viscosity of 0.00287 $\mathrm { m g m } ^ { - 1 } \mathrm { n i n } ^ { - 1 }$   
Calculate the molecular size of the molecules of diffusion co-efficient of $3 . 1 1 \times 1 0 ^ { - 7 } \ c m ^ { 2 }$   
/min at 95 °F.
